# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 and GTK4** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 with native GTK4 GPU drawing. GTK4 gains a GPU control and explicit high-DPI painting behavior, Linux NoDependencies discovers installed fonts again, and Tizen moves to a version 10 baseline. Review the Tizen and GTK4 migration notes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Tizen packages require Tizen 10** — The Tizen native packages now target `net10.0-tizen10.0`, and the managed minimum rises to Tizen 10. Older Tizen targets are no longer included. Retarget the application and its manifest to Tizen 10, or keep a compatible earlier package for older devices; non-Tizen .NET minimums are unchanged. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **GTK4 raster drawing defaults to physical pixels** — `SKDrawingArea` now sizes its backing surface, `CanvasSize`, and paint-event `Info` in physical pixels on high-DPI displays. Set `IgnorePixelScaling = true` for logical paint coordinates; `RawInfo` remains physical. GTK input coordinates are always logical, so adjust coordinate conversion and remove any application scaling that would otherwise be applied twice. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — The bundled renderer moves to Skia m156 without adding managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp's milestone package revision becomes 14.4.0.100 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — `SKGLArea` provides `PaintSurface`, `GRContext`, `EnableRenderLoop`, and `IgnorePixelScaling` on a GTK-owned OpenGL or OpenGL ES context. Use GTK's `QueueRender()` for invalidation. The control requires a working GPU context and has no software fallback. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies finds installed fonts** — The default font manager scans `/usr/share/fonts/` instead of returning empty typefaces when fontconfig is absent, restoring family-based font lookup and shaping with installed fonts without adding a fontconfig dependency. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly archives match .NET 11** — .NET 11 targets select Emscripten 6.0.2 native assets for SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. Existing .NET 8 and .NET 9/10 asset mappings are unchanged. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 keeps the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine. Its Tizen packages require Tizen 10, and its .NET 11 WebAssembly targets use the matching Emscripten 6.0.2 archives.
